Differs from other 1859 ms. map of the same area/subject in having different handwriting (esp. in the index), bar scale located in lower left panel, different coloration of concession areas, and slightly different name identification of the indexed streams.
Includes number-index of stream concession areas, giving the names of personal and corporate holders. The numbers correspond to the numbers along the multicolored river concession areas on the map.
Issued with 3 metal rings at top edge to enable wall hanging.
Printed former ownership label affixed to cloth backing: Iz knig Gennadīi︠a︡ Vasilʹevicha I︠U︡dina. No. 6/r.
Sheet sectioned to 15 panels to enable folding when not in use.
